signals.text: Really cute infinity ankle rope bracelet. Well made and fits well on my ankle. Looks great whether I am wearing a pair of jeans or shorts and is perfect for all types of casual wear. Highly recommend as an addition to your wardrobe.

These are going to work great for my 11 year old grandson. He wears a big boys size 5 shoe.  I purchased the medium for my 8 year old who wears a big boys size 2 shoe.  The 9/11's would have been huge on him - the 7/8 1/2's should be perfect.  Washed and dried nicely.
I wanted a loose fit sock and these have a 1" band on the top that are too snug.  I will donate these.  If you're looking for a looser fit, pass on these.
